dashboardQueries.name: 705275fd-62fe-440e-83c8-d780e0c5e389
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
security_result.description = /$anomaly_type$/ nocase
security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case
$time_bucket = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%B %d", "UTC")
match:
    $time_bucket, security_result.description
outcome:
    $count = count(network.session_id)
order:
    $time_bucket asc
limit:
    100

dashboardQueries.name: d15ca3bc-4607-4a3a-bbea-b7185c4ac0db
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
security_result.description = /$anomaly_type$/ nocase
security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case
$display_entity = re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", "")
$desc = security_result.description
$item = security_result.detection_fields["item"]
match:
    $desc, $display_entity, $item
outcome:
    $alert_count = count(network.session_id)
order:
    $alert_count desc
limit:
    30

dashboardQueries.name: 1180cc64-c8fa-4226-8eb6-d365b69e1327
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
security_result.description = /$anomaly_type$/ nocase
security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case
$anomaly_detection = strings.concat(security_result.description, " | ", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""))
match:
    $anomaly_detection
outcome:
    $item = array_distinct(security_result.detection_fields["item"])
    $item_count = count_distinct(security_result.detection_fields["item"])
order:
    $anomaly_detection asc

dashboardQueries.name: 0e23abe7-d061-414b-b3cd-3df16f4e1904
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
security_result.description = /$anomaly_type$/ nocase

$anomaly_detection = strings.concat(security_result.description, " | ", re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", ""))
security_result.rule_name = %corelight_use_cases.use_case
$use_case = security_result.rule_name
$item = security_result.detection_fields["item"]

match:
    $anomaly_detection, $item, $use_case

outcome:
    $first_ts = timestamp.get_timestamp(min(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%B %d, %I:%M:%S %p")
    $latest_ts = timestamp.get_timestamp(max(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%B %d, %I:%M:%S %p")

order:
    $latest_ts desc

limit:
    20

dashboardQueries.name: 46caafd3-8eb2-433d-a088-9fd73e16af03
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
observer.hostname =  /$sensor$/ nocase
security_result.description = /$anomaly_type$/ nocase
$display_entity = re.replace(additional.fields["original_entity"], "/\\d{1,2}$", "")
$score = cast.as_float(cast.as_string(cast.as_int(cast.as_float(security_result.detection_fields["item_score"])*100)))
$uid = network.session_id
$use_case_description = security_result.description
match:
    $uid, $use_case_description
outcome:
    $original_entity = array_distinct($display_entity)
    $item = array_distinct(security_result.detection_fields["item"])
    $item_score = array_distinct($score/100)
order:
    $use_case_description asc
limit:
    20
